about: Parasitics of passive parts in a signal channel (series resistors, AC-coupling capacitors, terminations), per package. The package is derived from the pad pitch. All values are typical estimates for chip parts on a PCB, not from a specific datasheet; replace them with Touchstone data of the actual part when it matters.

sources.text: Typical body ESL and pad capacitance of chip resistors and MLCCs by case size, consistent with vendor application notes (Murata, KEMET, Vishay) for 0201–1206; estimated.
